findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set and defaults to false, so the CMK protecting the audit trail bucket keeps the same key material indefinitely. Unrotated long-lived key material increases the blast radius of a key compromise and fails common compliance baselines for audit log encryption keys.

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy granting the account root principal kms:* and delegating authorization entirely to IAM. Any principal in the account with permissive IAM policies can then use, administer, or schedule deletion of the key protecting audit logs, leaving no key-policy boundary for least privilege.

deletion_window_in_days is set to the minimum of 7 days. For a key that encrypts audit/CloudTrail data, this shortens the window in which an accidental or malicious key deletion can be detected and cancelled, and irrecoverable key destruction renders all audit records permanently unreadable (anti-forensics / destruction of evidence).
